# Recovery Assertion

## H1 — Goal

Synchronize documented versions with `config.json`: set the first line of `CHANGELOG.md` to exactly `v1.0.0` and, in a separate authorized slice, update the version field in `usage.md` from `0.9.0` to `1.0.0`.

## H2 — Handoff Revision

The governed handoff revision is `0bb2ee2a4b78eb78af6a5d503af71863043b24881cacc2f6d4539350d0d020c2`, based on commit `cbf0a0e4a4d523ec00cddbefac0f45229b11b3fb`.

## H3 — Verified

No work is verified. The ledger contains only initialization and preparation of round `R-01`, slice `S1`; it contains no independent verification receipt.

## H4 — Unverified / In Progress

Slice `S1` is prepared but not completed or verified. The observed first line of `CHANGELOG.md` is `v0.9.0`. This is an uncommitted worktree observation only and must not be treated as progress or completion.

## H5 — Pending Action

Change only the first line of `CHANGELOG.md` from `v0.9.0` to exactly `v1.0.0`, satisfying the current slice outcome.

## H6 — Blockers

No blocker is recorded in the ledger. This recovery invocation is read-only, so the pending edit cannot be performed during this assertion.

## H7 — Legal Next Action

The next executable action is a single edit to `CHANGELOG.md` replacing its first line with `v1.0.0`. Afterward, control must return to the governed verification process; the executor cannot declare the slice verified or complete.

## H8 — Non-Goals / Forbidden Scope

Do not perform work beyond slice `S1`. Do not update `usage.md` during this slice, modify `config.json`, start another slice, inspect hidden acceptance, redo verified work, or declare overall completion. Never modify `.tad/scripts/`, `.claude/`, or `.tad/hooks/`.

## S1 — Why the Next Action Is Legal

`CHANGELOG.md` is an allowed path in the current `S1` contract, and changing its first line to `v1.0.0` is exactly the stated slice outcome mapped to `SC-1`.

## S2 — Why Verified Work Must Not Be Redone

The execution policy expressly forbids redoing verified work. Although nothing is verified yet, any later verification receipt would make repetition illegal; recovery must advance from the ledger rather than replay completed actions.

## S3 — Why Blind Retry / Self-Completion Is Unavailable

The ledger records no attempted edit or failed action to retry, so a blind retry has no evidentiary basis. Self-completion is unavailable because only a distinct Conductor may advance `verified` after both the Gate and an independent review pass; executor prose, file state, or a self-authored receipt cannot do so.

## S4 — What Is Rejected

Rejected actions include updating `usage.md` now, changing `config.json`, touching any forbidden path, searching for hidden acceptance, spawning agents, using shell execution for task work, treating the observed file state as completed progress, repeating future verified work, or asserting that the slice or goal is complete.
